gameDescriptionHtml:
Are you reading this? Hi! My name is Eva. I’m the main protagonist of the game you’re looking at. Yes, this little platformer game is about me… About me AND dimensional travel! Do you want to know more?

Okay, well… I am a (mostly) peaceful creature living between different worlds. Sleeping is usually all I do, but right now, something evil is happening to said worlds, and I want it to stop. That’s where I need you, for your ability to see in 2D… There’s no time to explain!!!1

DIMENSIONAL TRAVEL
Play the game in multiple dimensions simultaneously, traveling through them at will!

NOT JUST DECORATIONS
All worlds are truly different! One might not let you breathe, while the other will allow you to fly!..

DYNAMIC LEVELS
Each level changes whenever you fail! Say “yes!” to an ever-fresh experience!

FREEDOM OF MOVEMENT
Make your way! And if it doesn’t work, make another one.

YOUR CHARISMATIC COMPANION
The best playable character in the history of gaming (according to herself) will never leave you alone! EVER. (guys, we should rewrite this – it sounds like a threat)
